title: Wi-Fi Connection Failed
shortDescription: Hydrow rower cannot connect to your Wi-Fi network.
fullDescription:
Hydrow rowers stream live and on-demand workouts over Wi-Fi; a lost connection blocks most content. Causes are usually weak signal, changed password, or router issues.

Move the rower closer to the router or add a mesh point. Forget the network on Hydrow and reconnect from Settings > Wi-Fi.

fixSteps.title: Reconnect Wi-Fi
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Wi-Fi > select network > enter password.

faq.a: Hydrow supports both; use whichever is strongest.

title: Electromagnetic Drag Motor Error
shortDescription: Hydrow's EM drag system reported a motor fault.
fullDescription:
Hydrow uses a computer-controlled electromagnetic drag instead of a fan or water. When the control board can't drive or read the drag motor properly, you get a motor error.

A power cycle clears transient faults. Persistent motor errors usually need Hydrow support — the EM assembly isn't user-serviceable.
whenToCallPro: Drag motor service via Hydrow support.

title: Touchscreen Unresponsive
shortDescription: Hydrow 22" touchscreen is frozen or unresponsive.
fullDescription:
When the display freezes mid-workout or won't wake, a soft reboot usually fixes it. Hold the power button behind the display for 10+ seconds to force shutdown.

Recurrent freezes point to firmware issues — ensure auto-updates are enabled.

fixSteps.title: Force reboot
fixSteps.instruction: Press and hold power button 10 seconds until screen goes black; release and press briefly to restart.

title: Recoil Strap or Sensor Issue
shortDescription: Hydrow isn't reading the recoil strap pull correctly.
fullDescription:
Distance and stroke data come from optical sensing of the recoil strap. When output is erratic or zero, the strap may be frayed, twisted, or the sensor has debris.

Inspect the strap for wear; dust the sensor window near the drum with a microfiber cloth.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove any loose dust near drum with microfiber; do not open assembly.

title: Software Update Failed
shortDescription: Hydrow firmware/software update could not complete.
fullDescription: Failed updates usually stem from poor Wi-Fi during download. Retry on a stronger connection; reboot if stuck mid-update.

fixSteps.title: Retry update
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Software Update > Check for Updates.

title: Heart Rate Monitor Won't Pair
shortDescription: Hydrow cannot find or keep connection with BLE heart rate strap.
fullDescription:
Hydrow pairs with Bluetooth Smart heart rate monitors. Pairing fails if the monitor's battery is low or another app has claimed the connection.

Unpair from phones; replace strap battery; repair from Hydrow settings.

fixSteps.title: Repair
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Heart Rate > Forget; then Pair New.

faq.a: Any Bluetooth LE HRM — Polar, Wahoo, Garmin.

title: Seat Not Rolling Smoothly
shortDescription: Seat binds or makes noise on the rail.
fullDescription:
Seat issues are mechanical, not an error code — but Hydrow support treats them as a service concern. Dust and sweat get into the seat rollers over time; wipe the aluminum rail and the roller bearings with dry cloth.

If seat wobbles, tighten the roller wheel bolts.

fixSteps.title: Clean rail
fixSteps.instruction: Slide seat to one end; wipe rail with dry microfiber.

fixSteps.title: Check bolts
fixSteps.instruction: Hex-key the 4 roller bolts under seat for tightness.

faq.a: No — Hydrow says wipe dry only.

title: Hydrow Won't Power On
fullDescription:
If the Hydrow won't power on, check the power brick LED first — it should glow green when plugged in. Try a different outlet and ensure the DC cable is seated in the rower.

If the brick is dead, a replacement is easy to order from Hydrow support.

fixSteps.title: Check brick
fixSteps.instruction: Verify green LED on Hydrow power brick; swap outlets.

fixSteps.title: Reseat DC plug
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug DC barrel from rower, reinsert firmly.
